reviews.title: Buyer Beware: You can pay and receive nothing.
reviews.text: I don't usually leave one-star reviews, but I think other potential buyers should understand the risk. In my experience, this platform did not protect me as a buyer. I spent 130 dollars on a digital product, was told I'd get access, and that never happened. I reached out immediately, was told I'd be added, then my messages went unanswered. I opened a dispute and explained what happened. The seller's evidence only showed their product existed, not that I had actually been given access. Despite that, the dispute was decided in the seller's favor. What made this even more frustrating was what happened afterward. Support acknowledged that the access wasn't attached. Acknowledged that if the seller never grants access, I could end up paying and receiving nothing. But also said it wasn't an acceptable outcome, yet they couldn't refund or reopen the case. My issue isn't just the money. It's that the process never seemed to answer the core question. Did I actually receive what I paid for? For the amount involved, I expected a dispute process that thoroughly determined whether I received the product. I hope the platform improves that process so products actually have to be delivered, not just shown to exist.

reviews.title: this app protects scammers rather than customers
reviews.text:
The user experience on this platform is deeply concerning due to both policy and technical failures. First, the review system is completely restrictive; once a review is posted on a creator’s page, there is no option to edit or remove it, which prevents users from updating their feedback if a situation changes.
"Furthermore, the refund process is heavily biased, as the platform consistently sides with creators over buyers. By failing to hold creators liable for refunds, the app essentially enables a marketplace where scams can flourish without any consequences for the seller. There are numerous fraudulent creators on the app, yet very little is being done to protect consumers.
"Finally, the interface is extremely laggy and poorly optimized. Whether I am on my phone or desktop, I frequently have to zoom out just to get the full page to load or to see all the content. These technical glitches, combined with a lack of buyer protection, make the app very difficult to recommend.

reviews.title: Reinstated Accounts Punished Again – Support Ignores Contradictions
reviews.text:
I shouldn’t even give whop a Godamn star because my experience with their support and account management has been extremely frustrating and inconsistent.

I have had multiple accounts in the past that were suspended and then reinstated after Whop’s internal investigations. This should have cleared me to use the platform.

However, my current account was permanently suspended for being “linked to previously suspended accounts,” even though those suspensions were already lifted by Whop itself. This is a clear procedural contradiction.

What makes it worse is that support repeatedly closed my chats — multiple times — without addressing the actual issue. They repeatedly pasted a “final decision” message that completely ignored the contradiction in their own system.

Despite my efforts to clarify the situation and ask legitimate questions about their reinstatement policy, I have been denied any explanation or escalation, which is extremely frustrating and unprofessional.

If Whop claims to take violations seriously, they should also take their own investigations seriously. As it stands, their system punishes users even after their accounts have been cleared, and their support team is unhelpful and unresponsive.
